name: Windblown Wisp
body:
Windblown Wisp

School transmutation [air, curse]; Level adept 1, druid 1, hunter 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, M (a dandelion seed)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You place a subtle curse on a creature, making it more susceptible to the effects of air currents. For the purposes of winds and weather, the creature is treated as being one size category smaller.
